title: Predicting Crime Without History: What Makes a Place Attractive to Crime?
simple_summary: What if an area is completely new—like a brand new shopping mall or newly built metro station—with zero crime records? Risk Terrain Modeling looks at the physical features that attract crime: ATMs, liquor vends, dark alleys, and vacant lots.
key_concept: Layer Stacking: Each physical risk feature is like a transparent colored plastic sheet. Where 3 or 4 sheets overlap, the color is deepest red—flagging high risk even with zero past FIRs.
recommended_action: Problem-Oriented Policing (POP): Fix the environment! Fix broken streetlights, trim overgrown bushes, install mirrors at blind corners, and require security guards at late-night ATMs.
non_tech_takeaway: A hotspot map tells you WHERE crime occurred yesterday. Risk Terrain tells you WHY that corner attracts crime tomorrow. Fixing the broken bulb often prevents more crimes than a passing patrol car.
